free_tier.stated: One Small container per app, up to 4 apps, no credit card: 512 MB RAM, 0.25 vCPU, 10 deploys a day (at most 5 in any 12 hours), 100 running hours a month across the account, sleeps after 15 minutes without visitors. Quoted from the pricing page.

retention.stated: 100 running hours a month across the whole account, not per container, so four containers average about 25 hours each and the box sleeps after 15 idle minutes and takes about a minute to wake, which breaks any request that must answer cold.

interface_detail: web dashboard, GitHub push-to-deploy, an MCP connector (npx @snapdeploy/mcp), and an HTTP API reference at https://snapdeploy.dev/api for the /api/mobile/** endpoints, authenticated with a scoped personal access token or a legacy API key sent as X-API-Key; the docs/api path answers HTTP 404
chaining: 100 hours is enough for a daily batch job that runs a few minutes, and the 2 GB Docker image limit lets a real scientific Python image ship; it does not compose into anything always-on.
